guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Check Your Eligibility
guide.description: Visit the AIW3 airdrop page Connect your wallet Click “Verify Now” to view your status If your results appear incorrect, contact the AIW3 support team to request a manual review.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Visit the AIW3 airdrop page
guide.description: Go to the AIW3 airdrop page and open the Airdrop tab. This is where your points, tasks, and ranking live.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect your wallet and complete the tutorial
guide.description: Connect your wallet and then finish the onboarding tutorial on the Airdrop tab. Wallet binding is required for the snapshot, so do this before July 28.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check in daily
guide.description: Hit the check-in button every day. Rewards follow a 7-day cycle that climbs from 3 points on day 1 to 10 points on day 7, and missing a day does not reset your progress.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the community tasks
guide.description: Follow AIW3 on X, repost the featured campaign post, and join the AIW3 Telegram from the airdrop page. These one-time tasks pay 10 to 20 points each and take about two minutes.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Make daily predictions
guide.description: Complete at least one prediction market entry per day for 20 points. Three predictions in a day pays 50 points, and inviting a friend who completes a prediction adds another 30. The prediction tasks reset daily, so they compound fast for consistent users.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade on the platform
guide.description: You earn points for every 1,000 USDT in trading volume, plus milestone bonuses for consistent activity. You can grab USDT or SOL on Bybit , and if your funds sit on another chain, the widget below moves them over to Solana or BNB Chain in one transaction. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget O
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Publish AI strategies
guide.description: Create trading strategies and publish them to the Strategy Square. Strategy rewards are repeatable, so this suits users who want points without constant manual activity.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer friends
guide.description: Share your referral link from the airdrop page. Referrals earn bonus points when invited users stay active, and they stack with the daily prediction invite task.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Verify eligibility and claim
guide.description: Check the eligibility page from July 29, then claim your tokens when TGE goes live on August 3.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

适合。操作难度较低，建议按教程逐步完成。
